name: natalia
frame: game.clock=13; if(f===Math.round(n*0.5)){ const g=game.missions.goal; const d=document.querySelector('#dialog .next'); if(d && !document.querySelector('#dialog').hidden) d.click(); }; if(f>=Math.round(n*0.5)+1){ const g=game.missions.goal; if(g) game.teleport(g.x+0.5,g.y+0.5); }

name: chars
frame: if(f%30===0){ const bs=document.querySelectorAll('.char-btn'); const b=bs[(f/30)%bs.length]; if(b) b.click(); }

name: langs
frame: if(f===50){ document.querySelectorAll('.langs button')[2].click(); } if(f===90){ document.querySelector('#btn-lang').click(); } if(f===100){ document.querySelectorAll('.langs button')[5].click(); }

name: car
pre: game.paused=false; game.clock=13; if(!window.__c){ const s=game.findRoadSpot(1430,1375,0,120); if(s){ game.teleport(s.x,s.y,s.h); const c=game.spawnCar(s.x+Math.sin(s.h)*4,s.y+Math.cos(s.h)*4,s.h,'family'); window.__c=c; } } else if(game.player.mode!=='car'){ game.traffic.take(window.__c); game.player.enter(window.__c); }
